title: Apache RR 310 BTO Carbon (Dark Edition)
description: Tailored for Track-day circuits, the TVS Motor Company Apache RR 310 BTO Carbon (Dark Edition) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
